name: WorldMark

summaryEn: A unified benchmark suite for interactive video world models across multiple views, domains, and action sequences.
scale: 500 generation conditions across four view-domain settings
scaleZh: 四种视角与领域设置下共 500 个生成条件

access: Official prompts, action sequences, and evaluation code available
accessZh: 官方提示、动作序列和评测代码可用
verdict: 统一测量交互视频世界模型动作响应与时空质量的套件
verdictEn: A unified suite measuring action response and spatiotemporal quality in interactive video world models

evidence.sourceTitle: [2604.21686] WorldMark: A Unified Benchmark Suite for Interactive Video World Models
evidence.statement: A common action vocabulary and 500 standardized cases test command following and response dynamics in interactive world models.
